quarterly_data.quarter: TSMC press release: Sony Semiconductor Solutions and TSMC Agreed to Establish (08-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Sony Semiconductor Solutions and TSMC executed a legally binding definitive agreement to establish Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation as a joint venture in Koshi City, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan, as a core hub for the development and manufacturing activities required for volume production of image sensors for smartphones using advanced manufacturing process technology; the JV is expected to commence volume production in 2029. Sony will be the sole controlling shareholder (the JV is planned to operate as a consolidated subsidiary of Sony Group) and plans to transfer to it, through a company split, its newly constructed fab in Koshi City. Sony intends to lead the development of core image sensor technologies, product planning and product design, while the JV plans to leverage TSMC's advanced process technology and manufacturing expertise. The establishment is subject to required regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions.
